description: A plain rank-and-file chinese swordsman in the supplied pixel art style. A round grey iron helmet with a small knob, grey lamellar armor with pale trim, cream sleeves, dark bracers, a red neck scarf, a red waist sash with a red front cloth, dark boots with a tan band. He holds a short curved sabre in the right hand
face: A stern face with a short grey beard.
rear_detail: Seen from behind: the round grey helmet, dark hair under its rim, the red scarf, grey lamellar armor, the red sash, the sabre at his right side. Nothing hangs on his back.
guard_action: the right hand lifts the sword up in front of the body, the left hand stays free as a guard, the left foot steps forward and the knees bend

actions.move: Seamless combat run in place carrying the sword, no attack. The last frame leads into the first, no pause
actions.pa1: One diagonal downward cut. Frames 1-5 raise the sword and wind up; frame 8 the cut lands from upper right to lower left; frames 9-11 follow through. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The sabre stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.pb1: One level horizontal cut. Frames 1-5 the sword is taken far out to the right at chest height; frame 8 it cuts across level to the left; frames 9-11 follow through on the left. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The sabre stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.pa2: One rising cut from low to high. Frames 1-5 lower the sword and coil; frame 8 the upward cut lands; frames 9-11 the sword finishes high. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The sabre stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.ps1: Hidden low, then a rising cut. Frames 1-6 he folds the knees deep and hides the sword low behind the body; frame 8 the legs drive up and the sword cuts from below upward; frames 9-12 the body rises with it. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The sabre stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.

notes: 2026-11-19 make_configs.py. 평타 pa1 → pb1 → pa2, 전법 ps1. 무기 좌표는 원화에서 눈으로 잰 값(±2px), 가려진 끝은 추정. 기본 병종. 밋밋한 클립(p)만 쓴다. 늘어지는 천이 없어 streamers 없음.
